projects.name: Dynamic RAG Schema Designer
projects.description: Autonomous retrieval optimization system that generates, benchmarks, and selects retrieval configurations across chunking, embeddings, and reranking strategies.
projects.problem: Manual RAG configuration requires repeated decisions across retrieval stages and vector backends.
projects.solution: A FastAPI and React experimentation platform with real-time analytics and support for multiple vector backends.
projects.architecture: Query → Chunking → Embeddings → Vector Backend → Reranking → Evaluation

projects.name: ADCEA
projects.description: Autonomous Data Cleaning & Feature Engineering Agent for end-to-end dataset preparation and baseline AutoML training.
projects.problem: Dataset ingestion, profiling, cleaning, and feature engineering often require disconnected manual steps.
projects.solution: An end-to-end data processing application with asynchronous training pipelines, Argon2 authentication, and a lightweight SPA for live insights and model management.
projects.architecture: Dataset → Profiling → Cleaning → Feature Engineering → AutoML → Insights
